description: This file defines the AWS CloudTrail client class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various CloudTrail operations and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: CloudTrailClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS CloudTrail service, providing methods for managing CloudTrail resources and operations.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a CloudTrail resource.

methods.name: createEventDataStore
methods.description: Creates a new event data store.

methods.name: deleteEventDataStore
methods.description: Deletes a specified event data store.

methods.name: deleteResourcePolicy
methods.description: Deletes the resource policy attached to a trail.

methods.name: deregisterOrganizationDelegatedAdmin
methods.description: Deregisters a delegated administrator for an organization.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific channel.

methods.name: getDashboard
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific dashboard.

methods.name: getEventDataStore
methods.description: Gets details of an event data store.

methods.name: getEventSelectors
methods.description: Retrieves event selectors for a trail.

methods.name: getInsightSelectors
methods.description: Gets insight selectors for a trail.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves resource policy of a trail.

methods.name: putEventSelectors
methods.description: Puts event selectors to a trail.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Attaches an resource policy to a trail.

methods.name: registerOrganizationDelegatedAdmin
methods.description: Registers a delegated administrator for an organization.

methods.name: restoreEventDataStore
methods.description: Restores a deleted event data store.

methods.name: startEventDataStoreIngestion
methods.description: Starts ingestion into an event data store.

methods.name: stopEventDataStoreIngestion
methods.description: Stops ingestion into an event data store.
